item.title: Google's DeepCrossAttention achieves comparable model quality up to 3x faster
item.description:
📝 Comparison between a standard residual network and DeepCrossAttention (DCA). While a standard residual network uses rigid, additive point-wise connections with equal weighting, DCA introduces dynamic, learned routing weights (W) that allow each layer to selectively route and combine features from across the history of preceding layers. By allowing the network to dynamically select and retrieve high-resolution features from earlier layers, DCA eliminates the information dilution inherent to classic residual connections.
🔗 Read more: https://research.google/blog/supercharging-transformer-residual-connections/

item.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
item.description:
